manifest_grammar.empty_pieces: Retain interior empties; omit only the final empty tail.
manifest_grammar.unknown_commands: skip with block ordinal and explicit reason
manifest_grammar.field_encoding: opaque non-NUL bytes; no implicit locale decoding

archive.reuse: existing fixed Pako3.0.2 rawDeflate/CRC and ZIP parser; no bzip2 dependency
archive.profile: stored/rawDeflate; existing classic nonencrypted single-disk constraints
archive.directories: permitted including first entry, empty payload only; strict relative paths and tree conflicts checked
archive.self_updater: still selects first regular central entry; new all-entry API separate

native_operations.create: name/md5/path; matching target digest skips, otherwise download ZIP and extract to target parent
native_operations.append: name/old_name/path; missing names or missing base skip; ZIP extract to unzip staging, append named chunk to old file then move to name
native_operations.replaceto: create-like plus optional pre-download shell deletion of old_name; never executed by independent implementation
native_operations.retries: Application attempts each operation at most three times; actual failures not dynamically validated
native_operations.file_digest_scope: Native mapped file with low32 byte length; above4GiB unverified. Independent profile <=32MiB.
native_operations.post_download: Native digest is logged; observed success path has no mandatory second equality branch

independent_policies.paths: memory keys only, ASCII printable non-space relative paths, normalized backslash to slash, <=259B; reject traversal, empty components, drives, reserved names, trailing dot/space, aliases and file/directory collisions
independent_policies.final_digest: all operations require32 lowercase hex MD5 and final destination comparison; append enforcement and native post-download enforcement are stronger independent policies
independent_policies.input_ownership: clone byte inputs; own data fields; preserve caller originals; no partial output on failure
independent_policies.archive_binding: explicit blockOrdinal, unique matching consumed package; unused packages rejected
independent_policies.filesystem_transaction: none; provisional memory map only; no files touched
independent_policies.replacement_delete: old_name removed only from successful memory candidate, no shell or filesystem actions
independent_policies.repeat: no automatic retries or network; caller supplies all bytes
independent_policies.unverified: trust and authentication unverified, replacement not-performed
